In continuation to Commission's notificalion No.PSC-R(A)/19/2021 dated 18th

(Business Administration) and TGT (Accountancy) is second class bachelor degree in
Commerce @.Com.) from recognized University with B-Ed, vide letter No. DSE-
11027/112021-DSE-FD/1739 Dated 0110912022. It is also inforrn that those candidate who
have applied for the post of TGT(Economics) earlier and now interested to apply for the post
either TGT(Business Administration and Accountancy) that application with higher RID will

Those candidate who want to apply TGT(Business Administration) or TGT
(Accountancy) that they have to register through One Time Registration (OTR) with another

The last date for submission of online application is extended to 20& September,
2022 till 1600 hrs and other terms and conditions as stipulated in original advertisement
No.PSC-R(A/1912021 datad 7& Apil,2022 will remain same.
